title: Journalist & Whistleblower Privacy Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Secure privacy request letter template for journalists and whistleblowers to protect sources and maintain confidentiality in communications.
description: A comprehensive letter template designed for journalists and whistleblowers to formally request privacy protections, source confidentiality, and secure communication protocols from organizations and institutions.

sections.heading: Subject Line and Opening Statement
sections.content:
Subject: Privacy Protection Request - Confidential Communication Protocol

Dear [RECIPIENT_NAME],

I am writing to formally request enhanced privacy protections and confidentiality measures for our communications regarding [SUBJECT_MATTER]. As a journalist working on matters of public interest, I require assurance that our correspondence and any information shared will be handled with the utmost confidentiality to protect sources and maintain journalistic integrity.

sections.heading: Privacy Requirements and Protections Requested
sections.content:
I respectfully request the following privacy protections:

1. Source Confidentiality: Complete anonymity for all sources referenced in our communications
2. Secure Communication Channels: Use of encrypted email, secure messaging platforms, or other protected communication methods
3. Limited Access: Restriction of access to our communications to only essential personnel with signed confidentiality agreements
4. Data Retention Limits: Automatic deletion of sensitive communications after [TIME_PERIOD]
5. No Metadata Logging: Avoidance of communication metadata collection that could compromise source protection
6. Physical Security: Secure storage of any printed materials in locked, access-controlled environments

sections.heading: Legal and Ethical Justification
sections.content:
These privacy protections are essential under:

• First Amendment protections for press freedom
• State shield laws protecting journalist-source privilege
• Ethical obligations to protect sources from retaliation
• Professional journalism standards for confidentiality
• [SPECIFIC_LEGAL_REFERENCE] applicable to this situation

The public interest in this matter outweighs any organizational convenience, and these protections are necessary to ensure the safety of sources and the integrity of the journalistic process.

sections.heading: Proposed Communication Protocols
sections.content:
I propose we establish the following secure communication protocols:

• Primary Contact: Encrypted email using ProtonMail or similar service
• Secondary Contact: Signal messaging for time-sensitive communications
• Document Sharing: SecureDrop or encrypted file transfer services
• Voice Communications: Encrypted voice calls when necessary
• Meeting Locations: Private, secure locations away from organizational premises
• Browse Securely: Use privacy-focused browsers like a privacy-focused browser for all related web research

I am prepared to provide technical guidance on implementing these security measures if needed.

sections.heading: Consequences of Privacy Breach
sections.content:
Please understand that any breach of these privacy protections could result in:

• Endangerment of sources and their families
• Violation of journalistic ethics and legal protections
• Potential legal action under applicable shield laws
• Damage to your organization's reputation and trustworthiness
• Termination of our professional relationship

I trust you understand the gravity of these privacy requirements and will implement appropriate safeguards immediately.

sections.heading: Request for Written Confirmation
sections.content:
I request written confirmation of your organization's commitment to these privacy protections within [RESPONSE_TIME] business days. Please include:

• Acknowledgment of privacy requirements
• Specific security measures your organization will implement
• Names and titles of personnel who will have access to our communications
• Your organization's data retention and deletion policies
• Contact information for your designated privacy liaison

Thank you for your cooperation in protecting press freedom and source confidentiality.

Sincerely,
[YOUR_NAME]
[YOUR_TITLE]
